name: @pipeworx/mcp-chrome-web-store

tools.name: chrome_web_store_extension
tools.description: Chrome Web Store listing for ONE extension by its 32-character id: name, publisher, rating, rating count, user count, version, last-updated date, category, website. Public listing data, no login.

id.description: The extension's 32-character Chrome Web Store id, e.g. "cjpalhdlnbpafiamejdnhcphjbkeiagm" (from its store URL).

tools.name: chrome_web_store_search
tools.description: Free-text search of the Chrome Web Store: matching extensions with id, name, rating, rating count, user count, category, website. PLG/adoption signal — what tools people are actually installing.

query.description: Search keywords, e.g. "ad blocker" or "grammar checker".

tools.name: chrome_web_store_by_publisher
tools.description: Extensions on the Chrome Web Store attributed to one publisher/developer name, confirmed against each listing's own developer disclosure. Bounded by Chrome Web Store's own search — there is no public per-developer listing page, so this is an approximation of "all", not a guaranteed-complete catalog.

publisher.description: Publisher/developer name as it appears on a listing, e.g. "Grammarly".

max_checked.description: Max search results to open and check (default 10, max 25).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-chrome-web-store forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the chrome-web-store pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
